description:
Flying out to the outer planets, the HUD speed readout just says 'NaN km/s' the whole way. Looks completely broken.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: (a) what the HUD speed should display for outer-planet missions (a specific value or formula)
A: I don't know.

Q: (b) whether the HUD should use the static approximation (R_EARTH_AU + destination.a) / 2 or should read the actual transfer ellipse SMA from the arc computation (which would require exporting a from transferEllipse in mission-arc.ts or buildArcs in fly-moon-arc.ts)
A: I don't know.

Q: (c) what the ftp benchmark checks — the HUD display value, the arc geometry, or both
A: I don't know.
